notes.title: Added Chinese language and playback function
notes.notes:
We have released an update that significantly changed the functionality of the game.
- now there are even more AutoSave points
- added function for selecting a position to load
- added Chinese language
- fixed bugs

notes.title: The Dark Reflection OST is realized!
notes.notes:
Hurray! Finally released officially the soundtrack from the game "Dark reflection". This is 14 tracks of catchy tunes from the game, including the "Gates" (track recorded for the game, but not used). 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1288520/__Dark_Reflection_Soundtrack/?beta=0

All music is presented in two formats: High Quality WAV and MP3. The total playing time is about 30 minutes. All tracks written by Mad Soul Spy (aka Vyacheslav Bukhryakov). Mixed and mastered by Oleg Kozlov. The illustration on the cover: Peter Polyakov.
[previewyoutube=tl3L3wGV8ng;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Upgrade! Achievements added.
notes.notes: We added achievements in "Dark reflection". From which you will learn that this game is not what it seems: there are alternative endings, secret characters, and mini-games. Find them and get shiny-colorful achievements!
